summary.text: Son of Ctimenus or of Irus and Demonassa, Argonaut from the region of Lake Xynius.

story.text: Apollonius and Hyginus count Eurydamas among the crew; Hyginus makes him son of Irus and Demonassa, or of Ctimenus near Lake Xynius.
Apollonius sets his home at Dolopian Ctimene near the Xynian lake, and Hyginus, giving Ctimenus as one father, the city of the Dolopians by Lake Xynius.
